reviews.author: Abhinav
reviews.title: Quality delivered in all aspects!!
reviews.body: The Purchase and delivery experience was good as expected from Amazon. And the RO installation was also seamless, the best part is you re schedule your installation at any point of time at your convenience. And lastly the installation took less than 45 minutes and during the process the installation person was constantly uploading the videos and pics of the RO during installation so its good measure by UC to keep track of how its installed overall. Filtration is Good as expected and pricing justifies the Quality and durability. The 8 Liter storage is good but may not be enough for some househo

reviews.author: Anji
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Outstanding After-Sales Service
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Product & Outstanding After-Sales Service! 👏 I purchased the Native M2 Pro water purifier in March.... Initially, there was a delay of one or two days because the service technician had multiple purifier installation and repair jobs. I understand that such minor delays can happen, so I don't consider it a major issue. and after 8 months of usage, I can confidently say that the purifier is working in very good condition. The product quality and performance are excellent. 💧 On November 1st, the filter pipe broke and water started leaking. I immediately raised a service request

reviews.author: Saran Pulipati
reviews.title: Good results with the short term usage
reviews.body: It is been a week that we started using the urban native m2 pro and so far I'm satisfied with the results. We use ground water that has around 450 tds and using this purifier, it got the tds down to around 50. The taste is good too.

reviews.author: Vinodkumar
reviews.title: Excellent Water Purifier – Native M2 Pro
reviews.body: Very good product with a premium design and excellent build quality. The Native M2 Pro looks stylish and fits well in the kitchen. The purification process is convenient, and the water tastes clean and fresh. The overall user experience is good, and the product feels worth the investment. Hoping for reliable performance and reasonable maintenance costs in the long run. Overall, a good choice for home use. 👍

reviews.author: Deependra pathade
reviews.title: Absolute game-changer for home water purification!
reviews.body: I recently got the Urban Company Native M2 Pro installed, and I am thoroughly impressed. The build quality feels solid and premium compared to standard plastic purifiers. What stands out the most is the smart app connectivity—being able to monitor TDS levels, water quality, and filter health directly from my phone gives complete peace of mind. The water tastes fresh, crisp, and naturally balanced, thanks to the mineral and copper cartridge. Knowing that it logs local data even without a permanent Wi-Fi connection is a brilliant feature.
